## Change

Describe the concrete behavior changed and why.

## Validation

List the commands run, their results, and any checks that still need approved inputs or cloud access.

## Publication checks

- [ ] The staged changes contain no credentials, raw or restricted data, or saved notebook outputs.
- [ ] Relevant offline checks and GitHub Actions pass.
- [ ] Changes to methods, dependencies, inputs, outputs, and provenance are documented.
- [ ] Third-party attribution and licence notices are preserved.
- [ ] Remaining limitations and publication decisions are explicit.
